title: Request for Information - F-15 MITR-DVR Depot Activation Capabilities
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE LIFE CYCLE MANAGEMENT CENTER.FIGHTER AND ADVANCED AIRCRAFT.FA8634 AFLCMC WAQK F15
detail_text: This request for information focuses on the provision of the above-referenced Depot Activation capabilities for the F-15 EX’s current EX Modular Instrumentation Traffic Recorder (MITR) Digital Video Recorder (DVR). The repair and maintenance of the MITR-DVR requires not only the MITR-DVR itself but all associated parts/spares and the rights in technical data necessary to maintain and ensure the software used in the displays functions correctly to support verification of repairs at designated ALC.
